title: Vocabulary and physical clarity: combat, magic, narration
why: Isaac, 2026-10-14: elevated words used too unevenly; fights described in abstractions ('the line', 'measure', 'tempo', 'vector', 'geometry') instead of what the body physically does. Evidence from scenes/: 'the parry had cost him the line and the line was the only thing keeping him upright'; 'Kujo's lead leg was already gone from the line'; 'yanking Sonzai into a new vector'. Counts in the 15 newest scenes: 'the line' 99, 'measure' 88, 'tempo' 35, 'geometry' 37, 'vector' 24.
